Terms of Use

The conditions for using Voyager Tracker, written to be read rather than skimmed.

1. Purpose of the website

Voyager Tracker is a free, independent website that provides educational information about NASA’s Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 missions, calculated position estimates and related calculators. By using the site you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

2. Educational information only

Content is provided for general education and interest. It is not professional, scientific-operations, navigation or engineering advice, and it must not be used for any purpose where an error could cause harm or loss.

3. Estimated data and accuracy limits

Distances, speeds, light times, milestones and calculator results are calculated or estimated by this site from public reference data. They are not official NASA or JPL telemetry and may differ from official values. The methodology and known limitations are documented on the How It Works page. Mission facts are summarised in good faith from public NASA/JPL sources but may contain errors or become outdated; please report problems through the Contact page.

4. External links

The site links to third-party websites such as NASA, JPL and GitHub. Those sites are not controlled by Voyager Tracker, and their content, availability and privacy practices are their own responsibility.

5. Intellectual property

The site’s original text, code and visualisations belong to the Voyager Tracker project; the source code is published on GitHub. NASA/JPL data and materials remain subject to NASA’s own usage guidelines, and NASA’s name and insignia are used only to identify the source of information, never to imply endorsement. Short quotations and links for non-commercial educational use are welcome with attribution.

6. Independence from NASA and JPL

Voyager Tracker is an independent, unofficial educational project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by NASA or the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

7. Availability and liability

The site is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind, and may be changed, interrupted or discontinued at any time. To the extent permitted by law, the project is not liable for any loss arising from use of, or reliance on, the site.

8. Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated as the site changes, for example if advertising is introduced. The date below shows when the site, including this page, was last updated.

9. Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent through the Contact page.
